description.value: Adriana's is a compact sandwich and pizza shop in Tofino serving Italian-inspired subs, focaccia sandwiches, and wood-style artisan pizzas. The shop runs rotating specials — including a Friday meatball sub and a weekly feature pizza announced via Instagram — and supports online pre-ordering with in-store pickup. Its varied menu and quick-service format make it a practical mid-ride refuel stop in the heart of Tofino.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Adriana's is an active sandwich and pizza shop in Tofino with a Square-powered online ordering system and in-store pickup from '4-131 1st St'. The menu explicitly lists Vegetarian Sandwich, Caprese Sandwich, Broccoli Rob Sandwich, Vegan Pizza, and Vegetarian Pizza, confirming vegetarian/vegan options. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or on the website.
Address discrepancy: OSM records '131 First Street' but the website pickup page shows '4-131 1st St', indicating a unit number (4) absent from the OSM record.
OSM name 'Adriana's' is shorter than the full trading name 'Adriana's Sandwich Shop' used throughout the website; OSM name retained per instructions.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible quick-service restaurant in Tofino with confirmed online ordering and a broad menu; a straightforward include for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact email found on website contact page: adrianastofino@gmail.com. OSM cuisine tag 'sandwich' is accurate but underrepresents the menu, which also features pizza as a major category.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes Vegetarian Sandwich, Caprese Sandwich, Broccoli Rob Sandwich (broccolini-based), Vegetarian Pizza, and Vegan Pizza (tomato sauce, olive oil, olive, caper, basil)

wow_evidence: compact sandwich and pizza shop in Tofino...online pre-ordering with in-store pickup
